NFL DFS Projections Week 4: DraftKings Picks, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 4 · 12 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 4, 3:46 PM ET

Josh Allen carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 4 DraftKings main slate: 21.9 DraftKings points at $7,700. He holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 10,000 simulations. Christian McCaffrey holds the largest share at 33% for $7,700.

Behind Allen, the model's next four projections are Christian McCaffrey (21.6, $7,700), Jaxon Smith-Njigba (20.9, $9,100), Kenneth Walker III (20.6, $8,200) and Joe Burrow (20.2, $6,800). Joe Burrow returns the most per dollar of that group at 2.97 projected points per $1,000. Jaxon Smith-Njigba leads the wide receivers at 20.9 for $9,100, Josh Allen leads the quarterbacks at 21.9 for $7,700, and Trey McBride leads the tight ends at 17.1 for $6,500.

The 12-game slate runs from a 51.5-point total in JAX at CIN down to 38.5 in GB at TB. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 4, 3:46 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 10,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 4 DraftKings projections

Josh Allen, BUF vs NE ($7,700)

Josh Allen carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 21.9 DraftKings points at $7,700, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 1.7 points clear of Joe Burrow. The model includes 6.6 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 2.85 projected points per $1,000, 16th of 22 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 22.0 points with a simulated floor of 8.1 and a ceiling of 39.8, and he holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Buffalo is a 7-point favorite at home against New England, with an implied team total of 28.25 in a game totaled at 49.5.

Joe Burrow, CIN vs JAX ($6,800)

Joe Burrow projects 2nd at the position with 20.2 DraftKings points at $6,800, 5th on the main slate overall. The salary works out to 2.97 projected points per $1,000, 14th of 22 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Burrow averaged 20.2 points with a simulated floor of 7.6 and a ceiling of 37.3, and he holds 7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Cincinnati is a 2.5-point favorite at home against Jacksonville, with an implied team total of 27 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Value: Tyson Bagent, CHI vs NYJ ($4,800)

Tyson Bagent projects for 17.6 DraftKings points at $4,800, which works out to 3.68 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 22 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 5.2 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Bagent averaged 17.8 points with a simulated floor of 7.0 and a ceiling of 32.8, and he holds 3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Chicago is a 3.5-point favorite at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 43.5.

Value: Emanuel Wilson, SEA vs LAC ($4,700)

Emanuel Wilson projects for 13.9 DraftKings points at $4,700, which works out to 2.95 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 26 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 19.1 carries and 0.5 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Wilson averaged 13.9 points with a simulated floor of 4.4 and a ceiling of 28.8, and he holds 6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit.
